A combined cycle power plant has one gas turbine, a heat recovery steam generator and a steam turbine. It runs at full load. Hourly records give net electrical output (MW) together with ambient temperature (2 to 37 degC), ambient pressure, relative humidity and condenser vacuum. The plant has no inlet air conditioning. In cold weather the gas turbine reaches the rated limit of its generator, and the control system holds it at that limit. At 15 degC and 1013 mbar the gas turbine alone produces about 343 MW. The gas turbine generator is limited to 353 MW.
